passive.name: Clean Cuts
passive.description: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

spells.name: Double Daggers
spells.description: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing physical damage each and leaving two Feathers. Targets hit after the first take damage from each dagger.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Deadly Plumage
spells.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades for seconds that grants her % Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals % damage. When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself % Move Speed for seconds. If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Bladecaller
spells.description: Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing physical damage each. If or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation FeatherDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Featherstorm
spells.description: Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
